thought.text: Server dist not rebuilt. Let me build just the server:

reasoning_content: There's an issue now - the server dist was deleted but not rebuilt. I need to build the server specifically.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Install deps first
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm install 2>&1 | tail -3")
print("Install:", stdout.read().decode())

# Build server only
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm --filter @wasd/server build 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("\nServer build:", stdout.read().decode())

# Verify dist exists
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js")
print("\nDist:", stdout.read().decode())

# Run
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && timeout 8 node server/dist/index.js 2>&1 || true")
print("\n=== Run ===")
print(stdout.read().decode()[:600])

client.close()
EOF
